understanding.goal_understanding: Win each level by getting every goal tile marked with a '+' occupied at the same time by a selectable piece; when all goals are covered simultaneously the level reports WIN, and completing all levels wins the run.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Actions were issued by CLICKing a grid coordinate. A click could select a piece (if clicked on a selectable piece) or attempt to move the currently selected piece toward/onto the clicked tile according to the game’s movement rule; moves failed (no position change) when blocked by walls/obstacles, invalid paths/targets, or other constraints. Pieces could be moved between open tiles, with successful moves updating the piece’s coordinates and consuming one step from the level’s finite step budget.
